reading_notes: detection_s is the time from a kill to the first sample that is not live; it includes the sampler's own scheduling delay on a loaded machine (max 0.77 s), while the pass condition is that no sample taken at or after kill + poll interval + grace (0.2 s) is live: live_while_down = 0
recovery_s counts the restarts that were followed by live data before the next kill (810 of 1,000); missed_recoveries counts restarts that stayed up longer than the bound without recovering: 0

drill timings are scaled down from the contract (0.1 s polls, 0.1 s grace, backoff 0.05 s doubling to 0.4 s) so 1,000 kills fit in minutes; the contract timings (2 s, 1 s, 1 s to 30 s) run in the real-service drill
